title: Final Research Presentation Rehearsal
objective: Students combine story, slides, voice, graph language, and Q&A into a complete presentation.
context: Rehearsal notes: A class asked when frogs were seen at a pond. In equal periods it saw 3 in the morning and 7 at dusk. There was one visit per period.

items.prompt: Give a short talk with the question, the two counts and one limit.
items.answer: Time and frog counts; 3 morning, 7 dusk; one visit per period.
items.hint: Use three notes: question, result, limit.

items.prompt: Answer two audience questions: Which time had more? Would another day give the same result?
items.answer: Dusk. Another day could differ; repeat visits to check.
items.hint: Support the first answer with a count.

items.prompt: Ask for feedback. Name one change you will make for your next talk.
items.answer: Accept one specific change based on feedback about structure, delivery, or explaining a number.
items.hint: Try: Next time I will ___ so the audience can ___.
